known_limits.note: The wiki index source (discovery/sources.txt) failed in GitHub Actions run 41921300975 (https://github.com/traceroute87/RetroHatch/actions/runs/41921300975), as reported by the maintainer; the cause has not been analysed. Generic page-following stays in the crawler until the index source is proven. Wiki rows in this file come from earlier crawls and the 2026-11-04 page check, not from that run.
The wiki page text was never saved, only its links: wiki headings and descriptions are not recorded, and categories of wiki-only rows come from the file name.

Only the collection members with tracked per-item evidence are itemized as applications (funkey_sdl2_games: 7). The 43 games of joyrider3774/32blit_funkey are itemized (one application each, from package_evidence). The 29 picoarch core OPKs are NOT applications: they stay grouped under picoarch (package_evidence). Still missing for the 43 games: sha256 (never hashed, needs a download), per-game licence/upstream and description, and hardware tests.
Entries with evidence.audit come from docs/GITHUB_COVERAGE_AUDIT.md prose: their packages were not inspected, sizes and hashes are unknown, and source-only entries have no release package.
System add-ons named in the audit (SimpleMenu for RG Nano, FunKey Add-on, AdvanceMAME bundle) have no tracked URL and are not listed.

package_evidence.note: Raw package identities from the 2026-10-26 crawls, kept here because build/ is git-ignored. NOT applications and NOT in the snapshot: this section is never read by tools/make_inventory.py. Sizes are bytes as reported by the server (Range reads); the crawler did not hash these files, so NO sha256 exists for any row below. A hash needs a download, which is deliberately not done here. Import = turn a row into an `applications` entry (one per game / one per core group) and compute the hash then.
